consentPage.metaTitle: Photo Consent & Garment Protection — SafiHub Bukavu
consentPage.metaDescription: Laundry photo capture policy at SafiHub Bukavu: no faces, Cloudflare R2 encryption, 90-day purge, and customer rights.
consentPage.headerDescription: The transparent photo protocol to guarantee the integrity of your clothes in Bukavu without compromising your privacy.
consentPage.heroTitle: Core Commitment: Your Clothes, Nothing Else
consentPage.heroDescription: At SafiHub, we document the condition of items entrusted to us with photos exclusively to prevent inventory disputes or pre-existing damage claims. No photos capture people, faces, IDs, or home interiors.
consentPage.rulesSubtitle: During customer doorstep collection and partner laundry reception, condition photos may be taken in accordance with SafiHub specifications.
consentPage.authorized1: Tears, snags, or missing buttons noted before cleaning.
consentPage.authorized2: Major pre-existing stains or discoloration on delicate fabric.
consentPage.authorized3: Special or high-value items subject to custom pricing.
consentPage.authorized4: Photographic proof of sealed package handed over at delivery.
consentPage.prohibited1: Faces of customer, household members, or courier.
consentPage.prohibited2: Identity cards, financial documents, or bank cards.
consentPage.prohibited3: Interior of living spaces or personal belongings unrelated to laundry.
consentPage.prohibited4: Any non-compliant photo is immediately rejected and deleted.
consentPage.thresholdNoticeText: The courier always informs the customer before photographing any defect during joint counting. The customer can inspect the photo on the courier's screen in real time.
consentPage.lifecycleSubtitle: SafiHub infrastructure applies a highly secure storage model with limited retention, guaranteeing strict photo confidentiality.
consentPage.cardCompressionDesc: Every image is resized to max 1280px and compressed to WebP (< 300 KB) directly in the courier's browser. All GPS tags and EXIF data are purged prior to upload.
consentPage.cardSignedUrlsDesc: Photos are stored in a private Cloudflare R2 bucket. No direct public access is allowed. Viewing requires cryptographic signatures with limited validity (60 minutes).
consentPage.cardPurgeDesc: In accordance with our data minimization policy, all photos linked to an order are permanently deleted 90 days after delivery, unless a dispute is actively under investigation.
consentPage.rightsSubtitle: You retain full control over your personal data and permissions.
consentPage.cardAccountDesc: You can inspect your timestamped consents anytime in 'My Account' on SafiHub. You also have the right to request early deletion of photos linked to your completed orders.
consentPage.cardSupportDesc: For any complaint or question regarding photography and confidentiality, contact our local operations team on SafiHub official WhatsApp or by email at
